description: I'm Rakul, a 2nd-year Aeronautical Engineering student and founder of moonseekers. I'm passionate about aerospace engineering, aviation, space exploration and innovative technologies. I'm leading this team to develop a Lunar Landing Site Navigator for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. I welcome enthusiastic people who enjoy teamwork and problem-solving. We're looking for members skilled in Python, programming, web development, UI/UX, data analysis and space science. Let's build something together!
